sn48.21:1.4: yāvakīvāhaṃ bhikkhave, imesaṃ pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ samudayañca atthagamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ nābbhaññāsiṃ. neva tāvāhaṃ bhikkhave, sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddho paccaññāsiṃ.
sn48.21:1.5: yato ca kho’haṃ bhikkhave, imesaṃ pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ samudayañca atthagamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ, athāhaṃ bhikkhave, sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddho paccaññāsiṃ.
sn48.21:1.7: akuppā me cetovimutti, ayamantimā jāti, natthidāni punabbhavoti.
